summary: A WoodWing-style Digital Asset Management (DAM) layer that handles binary blob storage, on-demand image renditions, per-asset access control, CDN delivery, signed URLs, and outbound lifecycle webhooks — all scoped to the tenant (workspace/project/dataset) model.

intentions.title: Serve media assets at scale with minimal latency via CDN offloading and immutable cache headers
intentions.evidence: cdn.ex prefixes every delivery URL with a configured CDN base and fires cache invalidation on update/delete; delivery.ex stamps `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` + ETag headers and handles 304 Not Modified, so upstream CDN can serve the vast majority of asset traffic

intentions.title: Enforce per-asset, per-actor access control modelled on WoodWing governance
intentions.evidence: access.ex gates four permission levels (view, preview, original, edit_metadata) against bp_visibility (public/token/private), auth token presence, signed-URL validity, and editorial checkout state; permissions/2 is the API surface for response serialization

intentions.title: Deliver format-optimised image renditions (thumb/preview/hero/og) without burdening the upload path
intentions.evidence: renditions.ex generates lazily on first HTTP request or eagerly post-upload via processing.ex; four presets with explicit max dimensions + format (webp for hero, jpg for og); pluggable ImageBackend behaviour (vix.ex libvips default, magick.ex fallback)

intentions.title: Gate token-visibility assets behind HMAC signed URLs with TTL expiry
intentions.evidence: signed_url.ex appends ?_=sig&exp=unix to delivery paths and verifies via Plug.Crypto.secure_compare; delivery.ex calls sign only when visibility==token; access.ex consults SignedUrl.verify? as an alternative to session auth

intentions.title: Keep asset metadata (dimensions, CDN status, processing state) in the content graph as a live document
intentions.evidence: processing.ex runs probe→renditions→CDN publish and writes bp_processing_status + fileInfo.{width,height} + bp_cdn_status back to the mediaAsset document via Content.upsert_document after upload

intentions.title: Notify downstream systems of media lifecycle events via signed, retry-backed webhooks
intentions.evidence: events.ex dispatches media.uploaded/processed/deleted payloads with CDN URL map and sync_tags to per-dataset configured endpoints; retries on 5xx/network errors with three escalating delays; uses same signing scheme as document webhooks (Dispatcher.sign_payload)

intentions.title: Preserve multi-tenant isolation for media blobs (workspace/project/dataset scoping)
intentions.evidence: media_file.ex carries workspace_id, project_id, and dataset_id FK (W2 additive seam) with unique constraint on (path, dataset_id); delivery.ex supports a scope_prefix opt so scoped API responses emit /w/<ws>/p/<proj>/media/… paths that are signed against the requested scope, never the raw asset row
